name: resolveClassUsingCustomClassLoader
input: Serialized stream of a standard class and a custom ClassLoader passed to ClassLoaderAwareObjectInputStream constructor
expected: Returns the Class object loaded successfully using the provided custom ClassLoader.

name: resolveClassFallbackToThreadContextClassLoader
input: Serialized stream of a class not found in the custom ClassLoader but present in the current Thread's context ClassLoader
expected: Falls back to Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() and returns the successfully loaded Class object.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveByte
expected: Returns byte.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map after both Class.forName attempts fail with ClassNotFoundException.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveShort
expected: Returns short.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveInt
expected: Returns int.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveLong
expected: Returns long.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveFloat
expected: Returns float.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveDouble
expected: Returns double.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveBoolean
expected: Returns boolean.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveChar
expected: Returns char.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassPrimitiveVoid
expected: Returns void.class retrieved from the primitiveTypes map.

name: resolveClassThrowsClassNotFoundException
input: ObjectStreamClass with a fully qualified class name that does not exist in the custom ClassLoader, Thread context ClassLoader, or primitiveTypes map
expected: Throws ClassNotFoundException because the class cannot be resolved by any mechanism.

name: constructorInitializesProperly
input: Valid InputStream and a ClassLoader instance
expected: Successfully initializes the ObjectInputStream and populates the internal primitiveTypes map with all 9 primitive/void types.
